name: JEE Question Paper
description: Extract all questions from a JEE question paper according to this schema.

questions.description: List of all questions in the paper.

subject.description: Subject of the question. Must be one of: Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics.

questionText.description: Complete question text including mathematical expressions.

imageUrl.description: Path or filename of the extracted image if the question contains a diagram; otherwise null.

correctOption.description: Correct option if available in the document, otherwise null.
